title: Dive Kit Translations Schema
description: One locale's translation of one base dataset (datasets/i18n/<locale>/<base>). 'strings' maps a base record id to the translated values of that record's text fields, under the same field names. A missing id or field falls back to the base file's English.

generated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the file was last generated.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag of the translation. Example: 'de'.

base.description: The base dataset in datasets/ whose ids and fields this file translates.

license.description: SPDX licence id: the base dataset's licence.

source.description: Where the translations were taken from.

strings.description: Base record id to translated fields. Checklists: a checklist id carries name and description, a section id title, a step id label and description. Dive signals: a signal id carries name and description.
